name: List
description: Semantic list components for bullet lists, numbered lists, and unordered (no-marker) lists. Includes DescriptionList with DescriptionTerm and DescriptionDetail sub-components for key-value or term-definition content.

notes: List renders as <ul> for bullet and none variants, <ol> for number variant.

variant.description: List marker style. 'bullet' uses disc markers, 'number' uses decimal markers, 'none' hides markers.

spacing.description: CSS custom property name (without --) for the gap between list items.

as.description: Override the root element. Auto-selects ul for bullet/none, ol for number when not specified.

subcomponents.DescriptionList: Renders a <dl> description list for term-definition content.
subcomponents.DescriptionTerm: Renders a <dt> term within a DescriptionList.
subcomponents.DescriptionDetail: Renders a <dd> detail/definition within a DescriptionList.

do: Use 'bullet' for unordered collections of items.
Use 'number' for ordered or sequential items.
Use 'none' for styled lists without visual markers.
Use DescriptionList for metadata, key-value pairs, or glossary content.
dont: Do not place block-level elements (headings, dividers) directly inside ListItem.
Do not use a numbered list when order does not matter.
Do not nest DescriptionList items inside a regular List.
